d: Voluminous, curly honey-blonde hair is styled in a high, swept-up fashion with loose tendrils framing the face. The eyes are a soft lavender shade with a calm, neutral expression, set in a youthful face with a mature appearance. The build is slender with a curved silhouette, dressed in a lime-green crop top with a white logo, a purple and green oversized windbreaker worn off the shoulders, and short blue denim shorts with a white and red polka-dot lining. Accessories include oversized green drop earrings, a black choker with a red pendant, multiple colorful bracelets on the wrists, olive-green leg warmers, and off-white sneakers.
